chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked him about the sailors and the Bedouins: is there shortened prayer upon them? He said: No; their homes are with them.

key_terms.الْمَلَّاحِينَ: sailors; those whose livelihood involves travel by water
key_terms.تَقْصِيرٌ: shortening of the prayer during travel
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them; accompanying them in their movement

ai.seo_question: Do sailors and Bedouins perform qasr prayer while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning travelers whose mode of life keeps their dwellings with them, such as sailors and Bedouins. It indicates that the ruling of shortened prayer does not apply to them in the usual way, because their homes accompany them.
